Proposition
[Marden quasi-Fuchsian criterion] 1. Proposition 8.7.2\group quasi-Fuchsian groupsSource: thurston:page-0207 For a torsion-free Kleinian group, quasi-Fuchsianity is equivalent to $N_\Gamma $ being homeomorphic to $S\times \R $ with compact convex core and to each component of $\partial M_\Gamma $ being a finite-area surface whose inclusion is a homotopy equivalence.
Proof

\sketch A quasiconformal conjugacy transfers the Fuchsian product picture. Conversely, the two boundary components and the convex deformation theorem give a quasiconformal sphere conjugacy, whose invariant separating curve is the limit set.

□
